read_me_first.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
because: SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
SPY sits 1.68 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits 4.0 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.85 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Infra Power, Enterprise Software, Cybersecurity — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

gex.commentary: Just above flip: fragile. A small drop enters the wild zone.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Calm market — dealers are long gamma and dampen moves (price tends to pin): support ~767, breakdown level ~775 (losing it turns the market volatile), resistance ~785.

neighbourhood: On both the week and month lists (real leadership): Infra Power, Enterprise Software, Cybersecurity, Gaming Streaming, Semiconductors
Leading from their own highs, not just bouncing: Enterprise Software, Mag7, Biotech, Cybersecurity
Strong numbers but still well off their highs (a bounce, not leadership yet): Oil Services, Agri Commodities, Critical Minerals, AI Infrastructure, Gaming Streaming
